result:
I built the project and everything passes. In one clean run, the build, the 14 unit tests, and the UI test all passed. The UI test ran on the emulator against your real backend and walked through login → event list → seat map → my tickets → ticket details.

## Commands I ran and their results

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.9 --distribution-type bin` | Created the Gradle wrapper. The first two tries failed because there was no settings file yet, then no `app/` folder. |
| `./gradlew :app:generateApiClient` | Generated the API client from `openapi.yaml`. It warns that OpenAPI 3.1 support is still in development. |
| `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest assembleDebugAndroidTest` | **Failed the first time**: the `/health` response has `ok: {type: boolean, const: true}`, which the generator wrongly turns into a String enum, so it doesn't compile. After the fix (see below): BUILD SUCCESSFUL. |
| `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.DEMO_EMAIL=demo-buyer@example.com -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.DEMO_PASSWORD=password1` | **Failed the first time**: after a successful login the list never appeared. **Failed the second time**: a bug in the test itself. **Passed the third time.** |
| `adb logcat -d` / `adb install` / `adb shell input …` / `android layout` / `android screen capture` | Used to find the causes and to check the four screens by eye. |
| `./gradlew clean assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest connectedDebugAndroidTest -P…DEMO_EMAIL=… -P…DEMO_PASSWORD=…` | **Final clean run: BUILD SUCCESSFUL.** Unit tests 14/14 (formatting 5, seat map 5, token handling 4). UI test: `run finished: 1 tests, 0 failed`. |

During the UI test, logcat shows these requests, all returning 200: `POST /auth/login` → `GET /events?status=on_sale` → `GET /events/{id}` → `GET /orders` → `GET /orders/{id}`.

## Problems I hit and fixed
1. **The generator can't handle `const` in OpenAPI 3.1.** The app doesn't use `/health`, so `app/openapi-generator-ignore` skips that endpoint's generated code. Nothing else was hand-written.
2. **The app tried to navigate off the main thread after login.** The test screen showed "Method setCurrentState must be called on the main thread". This only happens under the test environment's coroutine setup. The fix switches to the main thread before navigating, in the login screen and in the "back to login when the session ends" logic.
3. **The test couldn't find the amount on a ticket card.** Because the whole card is clickable, the amount's test tag is hidden. The test now looks it up a different way (`useUnmergedTree = true`).
4. **The order number overlapped its label** on the details screen (spotted in a screenshot). Fixed by putting the value in its own right-aligned column.

## About the project
- **Versions:** AGP 8.7.3, Gradle 8.9, Kotlin 2.0.21, Compose BOM 2024.12.01 (all already in your local cache), OpenAPI Generator 7.10.0 (kotlin / jvm-okhttp4 / moshi). The API client is generated into `app/build/generated/openapi` before every build.
- **API address:** `BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL` defaults to `http://10.0.2.2:8788`. You can override it with `-PapiBaseUrl=…`. Plain `http` is allowed only for 10.0.2.2, 127.0.0.1 and localhost.
- **Login:** the access and refresh tokens are saved in SharedPreferences. When the access token expires (a 401), the app gets a new one with the refresh token once and resends the request. Refreshes are done one at a time, because the backend revokes all refresh tokens if an old one is reused. If the refresh is rejected, the saved tokens are cleared and the app returns to the login screen.
- **Amounts:** `formatCents` in `ui/format/Formatters.kt` turns cents into `NT$4,444.20`. It uses exact decimal arithmetic and ignores the phone's language, and unit tests cover this.
- **Seat map:** 10×10 and read-only, with four colours and a legend. Each seat also has a spoken description for screen readers (e.g. "C3 我的"), so the state isn't shown by colour alone.

## Things to know
- Tokens are stored in plain SharedPreferences, not encrypted. Backups are turned off (`allowBackup=false`).
- The UI test requires at least one on-sale event and at least one order on the backend; otherwise it fails with a clear message. The demo account meets both today.
- The entry code on the ticket details screen is shown as text only, not drawn as a QR code; that would need an extra library.

Screenshots of the four screens are in `app/build/shot-*.png`.
